categories.name: Email-Based Adversary Tradecraft
categories.description: How attackers abuse Exchange Online for persistence, access, and evasion.

ttps.name: Mailbox Email Forwarding
ttps.description: Attackers configure mailbox forwarding to maintain persistent access to communications without continued authentication or malware.

pivotSteps.purpose: Find an external forwarding change and collect the affected user and source IP.
pivotSteps.kql:
OfficeActivity
| where Operation == "Set-Mailbox"
| where tostring(Parameters) has "ForwardingSmtpAddress"
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, Parameters

pivotSteps.purpose: Pivot on UserId and ClientIP to identify the OAuth application that made the change.
pivotSteps.kql:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "MailboxForwardingConfigured"
| where AccountId == "<UserId>" and IPAddress == "<ClientIP>"
| project Timestamp, OAuthAppId, ObjectName, IPAddress

pivotSteps.purpose: Pivot on OAuthAppId and IPAddress to the application sign-in that contains the flag.
pivotSteps.kql:
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where AppId == "<OAuthAppId>" and IPAddress == "<IPAddress>"
| project TimeGenerated, ServicePrincipalName, UserAgent

ttps.name: Malicious Inbox Rules
ttps.description: Attackers create or modify inbox rules to hide security notifications, intercept messages, or redirect mail while avoiding user awareness.

pivotSteps.purpose: Find a rule that suppresses security mail and collect the mailbox identity and source IP.
pivotSteps.kql:
OfficeActivity
| where Operation == "New-InboxRule"
| where tostring(Parameters) has_any ("DeleteMessage", "MoveToFolder")
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, Parameters

pivotSteps.purpose: Pivot on UserId and ClientIP to recover the authentication correlation ID.
pivotSteps.kql:
SigninLogs
| where UserPrincipalName == "<UserId>" and IPAddress == "<ClientIP>"
| where AppDisplayName == "Office 365 Exchange Online"
| project TimeGenerated, CorrelationId, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress

pivotSteps.purpose: Pivot on CorrelationId to the automated session event that contains the flag.
pivotSteps.kql:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where CorrelationId == "<CorrelationId>"
| project TimeGenerated, AppDisplayName, IncomingTokenType, AuthenticationDetails

categories.name: Identity-Based Adversary Tradecraft
categories.description: How attackers abuse identity, authentication, and authorization to gain access and persist in cloud environments.

ttps.name: Token Abuse
ttps.description: Attackers steal or reuse authentication tokens to maintain access without repeated sign-ins or MFA challenges.

pivotSteps.purpose: Find the risky device-code authentication and collect its session ID.
pivotSteps.kql:
SigninLogs
| where AuthenticationProtocol == "deviceCode" and ResultType == "0"
| where IsRisky and IsInteractive
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, SessionId, IPAddress

pivotSteps.purpose: Pivot on SessionId to the refresh-token activity that contains the flag.
pivotSteps.kql:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where SessionId == "<SessionId>" and not(IsInteractive)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IncomingTokenType, AuthenticationDetails

ttps.validationKql:
let Seed = SigninLogs | where AuthenticationProtocol == "deviceCode" and ResultType == "0" and IsRisky and IsInteractive and isnotempty(SessionId) | project SessionId;
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where not(IsInteractive) and isnotempty(SessionId) | project SessionId, Flag=AuthenticationDetails | join kind=inner Seed on SessionId | project Flag

ttps.name: Conditional Access Policy Abuse
ttps.description: Attackers modify Conditional Access policies to weaken MFA, device compliance, or location enforcement while access still appears policy-compliant.

pivotSteps.purpose: Find the Conditional Access policy update and collect its audit correlation ID.
pivotSteps.kql:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName == "Update conditional access policy"
| project TimeGenerated, Identity, CorrelationId, TargetResources

pivotSteps.purpose: Pivot on CorrelationId to recover the changed policy object ID.
pivotSteps.kql:
CloudAppEvents
| extend AuditCorrelationId=tostring(RawEventData.AuditCorrelationId)
| where AuditCorrelationId == "<CorrelationId>"
| project Timestamp, ObjectId, AccountId, IPAddress

pivotSteps.purpose: Pivot on ObjectId to a sign-in evaluated against the weakened policy; this row contains the flag.
pivotSteps.kql:
SigninLogs
| where tostring(ConditionalAccessPolicies) == "<ObjectId>"
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationDetails

categories.name: Application-Based Adversary Tradecraft
categories.description: How attackers abuse cloud applications, APIs, and automation to access data and persist without interactive users.

ttps.name: API Access Abuse
ttps.description: Attackers abuse application API permissions or service principals to access cloud resources without interactive user sign-ins.

pivotSteps.purpose: Find the application consent and recover the service principal object ID.
pivotSteps.kql:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName == "Consent to application"
| where tostring(AdditionalDetails) has_all ("Files.Read.All", "Directory.Read.All")
| extend ServicePrincipalId=tostring(TargetResources[0].id)
| project TimeGenerated, Identity, ServicePrincipalId

pivotSteps.purpose: Pivot on ServicePrincipalId to recover the issued token identifier.
pivotSteps.kql:
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where ServicePrincipalId == "<ServicePrincipalId>"
| project TimeGenerated, AppId, UniqueTokenIdentifier, IPAddress

pivotSteps.purpose: Pivot on UniqueTokenIdentifier to the Graph request that contains the flag.
pivotSteps.kql:
GraphAPIAuditEvents
| where UniqueTokenIdentifier == "<UniqueTokenIdentifier>"
| project TimeGenerated, ApplicationId, RequestMethod, RequestUri, ResponseStatusCode

ttps.name: Cloud Data Collection (Non-Mail)
ttps.description: Attackers access SharePoint, OneDrive, or storage data through legitimate APIs or application access without traditional endpoint activity.

pivotSteps.purpose: Find suspicious application-based file access and collect the object ID.
pivotSteps.kql:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "FileAccessed" and AccountType == "ServicePrincipal"
| project Timestamp, ObjectId, OAuthAppId, IPAddress

pivotSteps.purpose: Pivot on ObjectId to confirm API retrieval and its application context.
pivotSteps.kql:
GraphAPIAuditEvents
| where ReportId == "<ObjectId>"
| project TimeGenerated, ReportId, ApplicationId, RequestMethod, RequestUri

pivotSteps.purpose: Pivot on ReportId to the corresponding file-download audit row that contains the flag.
pivotSteps.kql:
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeObjectId == "<ReportId>" and Operation == "FileDownloaded"
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, OfficeObjectId, SourceFileName, ClientIP
